description: Figures README.md states about related projects. They are measured in those projects, not in matrix.json, so each is pinned here with the release and commit it was read from. scripts/check_readme_claims.py fails when a README line naming the project states a different number in one of the wordings the script reads; a figure worded any other way is not checked. For DVAA the wordings are 'N agents', 'N deliberately vulnerable', 'N hardened reference', 'N control-protected variant(s)', 'N vulnerable agent(s)' and 'N categories' (up to two words, each a run of ASCII letters and hyphens, may stand between the number and 'categories'), each read in any letter case with one space between words. A README line naming the project that carries a format character (Unicode category Cf), a control character (category Cc) other than a tab, a Hangul filler or a combining mark Unicode lists as default ignorable fails, because such a character can keep a figure from being read. Re-measure with the refresh command when the project releases.

dvaa.source: README.md: the Security column of the Agents table, and the rows of the Attack Categories table
dvaa.refresh: curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opena2a-org/damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/main/README.md | grep -E "^\| [A-Za-z-]+ \| 70[0-9]{2} \|" | awk -F'|' '{gsub(/ /,"",$4); print $4}' | sort | uniq -c
